visualCharacteristics.purpose: considerations copy beside a photo with an acknowledgement checkbox that enables the tool start button
visualCharacteristics.structure: image + heading + text + list + field + link

contentPattern.structure: row 1: image | heading + text + list + start link. Optional row: `I understand | checkbox` (added automatically when missing). The last link-only paragraph is the gated start link

reuseGuidance: Use when visitors must acknowledge a disclaimer before launching a tool. The start link is disabled until the box is checked.
